## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Restore `--wait` before merging so existing scripts keep working during the documented one-release deprecation period.

## Changes

The pull request renames `--wait` to `--timeout`, updates the parser tests, and adds an architecture decision describing the transition. It retains the 30-second default and the JSON and CSV output choices.

## Critical

- app/cli.py:6 — correctness — Keep `--wait` as a deprecated alias — `--wait 12` now exits with status 2 because the parser registers only `--timeout`. `docs/adr/007-timeout.md:5` says, “Accept `--wait` as an alias for one release and emit a deprecation warning when it is used.” — Existing scripts that pass `--wait` stop during argument parsing. — Fix: Route both flags to `args.timeout`, warn only when `--wait` is used, and extend `test_explicit_options`.
